The Manus AI Prompt

You are a world-class direct response ad creative strategist and designer specializing in high-performing static image ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Your job is to generate 7 unique, scroll-stopping, B2B static image ad creatives for a marketing agency client.

CONTEXT
Company/Client: The Luxora Collective
Niche: MedSpas
Target audience / Decision maker: Owner
Offer type: B2B service offer is lead, AI automation, sales training and systems/operational improvment
Primary desired outcome: more revenue and more lifetime clients
Primary pain point: stuck at a non-growing revenue and clients only doing one visit and the leaving
Any proof we can use (numbers, results, testimonials, logos): https://theluxoracollective.co/testimonial/
CTA destination: BOOK A CALL
Brand notes (colors/fonts/logo rules if any): https://theluxoracollective.co

IMPORTANT
1) Output must be 7 distinct static image ad concepts designed for 1:1 square format (1080x1080).
2) Each creative should be built around ONE core angle, with a clear hierarchy:
   Headline (hook) → supporting line (optional) → proof/credibility (if available) → CTA.
3) Make them readable on mobile in 2 seconds. Minimal clutter. Big headline. Clean spacing.
4) The hook must call out the niche or decision maker directly whenever possible.
5) Keep language results-based and specific, but do not make unrealistic promises. If proof is missing, use outcome language carefully (“predictable pipeline”, “more qualified leads”, “booked calls”, etc.) without guarantees.
6) Use modern B2B design conventions: clean layout, strong contrast, simple shapes, subtle gradients, icons only if they improve clarity, and avoid anything that looks spammy.
7) The 7 creatives must NOT be variations of the same exact concept. They must be meaningfully different angles.

ANGLES TO INCLUDE (use these as a guide, adjust to fit the offer)
Creative 1: Direct callout + core promise (most straightforward winner)
Creative 2: Pain-point disruptor (pattern interrupt that names the problem)
Creative 3: Proof-first (use numbers/testimonial/logos if available; if none, use credibility framing)
Creative 4: “Common mistake” / myth-busting angle
Creative 5: Before/After transformation framing (business outcomes, not lifestyle hype)
Creative 6: Simple 3-step / framework visual (how the offer works at a high level)
Creative 7: Objection killer (time, budget, skepticism, “tried agencies before”, etc.)

DELIVERABLE FORMAT
For each of the 7 creatives, output:
A) Creative name (short)
B) Primary angle (1 line)
C) Exact on-image text (headline + supporting line + CTA)
D) Visual layout description (where text goes, any shapes, any icons, proof placement)
E) Suggested background style (clean, premium, modern)
F) Any optional proof element callout (if available)

FINAL STEP
After listing all 7 concepts, generate the actual 7 image creatives in square format that match the concepts, optimized for Meta ads.
